name: ECCC nearby-community air quality
description: Official Canadian named-community AQHI observations and forecasts as non-covering secondary evidence

eccc-aqhi-geomet.purpose: Find and preserve nearby official ECCC named-community air-quality observations and forecasts
eccc-aqhi-geomet.dataSent: A server-derived bounding box around the requested coordinates and the requested forecast time window
eccc-aqhi-geomet.dataReceived: Public community IDs, bilingual names, coordinates, AQHI numeric values, observation or forecast times, and forecast publication times. Cached 5–10 min.
